name: Hellfire Imps assist their knight after an AoE spell without melee auto-attack (#10433)
contract: Issue #10433: Call: Hellfire Imp (804883) summons Hellfire Imp 50301 to aid the Knight of Xoroth in battle.
npc_ascension_xoroth_summon::UpdateAI only checked player->GetVictim(), which is null unless the knight starts
melee auto-attack, so imps stood idle when the knight fought with AoE spells such as Flames of Xoroth (rank 7,
573448). Expected: a summoned Hellfire Imp leaves an unengaged hostile enemy alone, and once the knight hits
that enemy with Flames of Xoroth without ever starting melee auto-attack, the imp engages and damages it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: one Hellfire Imp is out
Confirm the imp does not pull an unengaged enemy and clear GCD
CONTROL: the unengaged enemy stays out of combat
CONTROL: the unengaged enemy stays at full health
Engage with AoE Flames of Xoroth only (no melee auto-attack)
SETUP: Flames of Xoroth hit the enemy
SETUP: the enemy is in combat
DISCRIMINATING: the Hellfire Imp damages the AoE-engaged enemy
